BALOCHISTAN WILDLIFE (PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND
MANAGEMENT) RULES, 2015
BALOCHISTAN WILDLIFE
(PROTECTION, PRESERVATION, CONSERVATION AND MANAGEMENT) RULES, 2015
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary, 12th January, 2016]
No. Forest/ SO (Dev.1)5-16/2014/149-60, dated 12.1.2015.---In
exercise of the powers conferred under section 69 of the Balochistan Wildlife
(Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 2014 (Act No. XV
of 2014), the Government of Balochistan is pleased to make the following rules
for the purposes of carrying into effect the provisions of the Act:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be called the Balochistan Wildlife (Protection, Preservation,
Conservation and Management) Rules, 2015.
(2) They shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---In these rules, unless there
is anything repugnant in the subject or context:
(a) Act means The Balochistan Wildlife (Protection,
Preservation, Conservation and Management) Act, 2014 (Act No. XV of 2014);
(b) Form means the form appended to these rules;
(c) Schedule means a schedule appended to the Act;
(d) Private hunting license means a license issued by the owner
or owners of a private game reserve and counter signed by the Conservator of
Forests of that particular jurisdiction for hunting in the private game
reserve, other than the big game animals for which a separate trophy hunting
permit needs to be issued under these rules;
(e) Trophy Hunting means the hunting of big game animals as
prescribed in Part-C, Schedule-I of the Act in a manner as prescribed under
these Rules;
(f) Manager means the Deputy Conservator of Forests or Divisional
Forest Officer for managing a National Park, Wildlife Sanctuary or a Game
Reserve or the owner for managing a Private Game Reserve or a Community Game
Reserve.
(2) All words and expressions used but not
defined here above in sub-rule (1) shall unless the context requires otherwise,
have the meaning as assigned to then in the Act.
3. Validity of
license or permit.---Every license or permit issued under these
rules shall be valid upto 31st December each calendar year or otherwise expires
on the dates mentioned thereon and shall be valid for Balochistan province
only.
4. Officers
empowered to issue license or permit.---All license or permits under
the Act shall be issued or renewed by Forest and Wildlife Officers. All special
permits, imports or export permits under the Act shall be issued by the Chief
Conservator of Forests or Conservator Wildlife and National & Parks. The
license or permits shall have pasted there in a photograph, entry of the CNIC
No. or passport No. of the holder, as the case may be, and payment of the
prescribed fee; paid in cash or through Bank challan.
5. Eligibility
for Permit/License.---A person of eighteen years or above, through
an application in writing may apply for any license/permit under these rules.
6. Serving of
wild animals/birds meat in hotels etc.---No person shall cook or
serve in any public place, hotel, caf , restaurant, hostels, boarding houses,
or any other catering place meat of any wild bird or animal mentioned in the
first Schedule I and III of the Act, except when the birds or animals have been
shot in accordance with the rules and during the period specified for each
species.
7. Constitution
of Raid Party.---The Chief Conservator of Forests may
constitute a raid party for carrying into effect the provisions of the
Balochistan Wildlife (Protection, Preservation, Conservation and Management)
Act, 2014 within the meaning of Section-79 of the Act.
8. Houbara
bustard hunting through foreign dignitaries.---(1) As provided
in Schedule-III of the Act, the Houbara bustard is a protected bird, but it
will be considered as Game bird as reflected in Schedule-I (part-D) of the Act,
only for foreign dignitaries for hunting season from November 15 to February
15.
